title: Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing
abstract: arXiv:2610.13786v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete graph diffusion models (GDMs) corrupt the graph structure by adding noise independently to nodes and edges under a Markovian noise model. In the unconditional setting without node features, an equivariant denoiser trained on a single graph is able to generate novel graphs and sample-level metrics such as edge overlap and WL kernel similarity find no evidence of memorization. In this work, we challenge this view and show for the first time that graph diffusion models indeed exhibit memorization. Analyzing the reverse diffusion trajectories of GDMs trained on two-block stochastic block models (SBMs), we find a strong train-data bias: the model recovers a corrupted training graph almost perfectly compared to a held-out test graph. We term this conditional memorization, as it surfaces only when the reverse trajectory is conditioned on a corrupted training graph and is not apparent during inference. It coincides with a growing gene

translated_title: 你的离散图扩散模型正在秘密记忆
translated_abstract: 离散图扩散模型（GDMs）在马尔可夫噪声模型下，通过独立地向节点和边添加噪声来破坏图结构。在没有节点特征的无条件设置下，在单个图上训练的等变去噪器能够生成新颖的图，并且边重叠和WL核相似度等样本级指标未发现记忆化的证据。在这项工作中，我们挑战了这一观点，并首次证明图扩散模型确实表现出记忆化。通过分析在双块随机块模型（SBM）上训练的GDM的反向扩散轨迹，我们发现存在强烈的训练数据偏差：与保留的测试图相比，该模型几乎完美地恢复了被损坏的训练图。我们将这种现象称为“条件记忆化”，因为它仅在反向轨迹以损坏的训练图为条件时才会显现，而在常规推理过程中并不明显。它与不断增长的基因（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次证明离散图扩散模型存在“条件记忆化”现象——当反向扩散轨迹以损坏的训练图为条件时，模型几乎能完美恢复该训练图，而这种记忆化在常规推理和样本级评估指标中均无法被察觉。
en_tdlr: This work provides the first evidence that discrete graph diffusion models exhibit "conditional memorization" — the model recovers a corrupted training graph almost perfectly when the reverse trajectory is conditioned on it, a phenomenon that remains invisible during standard inference and to sample-level metrics.
